instruction: Complete the task entirely in the Abaqus/CAE graphical user interface. Analyze Saint-Venant torsion of a rectangular solid bar in the N-mm-MPa unit system. Create a 3D deformable solid 150 mm long in global X with a 20 mm by 10 mm Y-Z cross-section. Define Steel with E = 210000 MPa and nu = 0.3, assign a solid homogeneous section, and create one dependent instance. Create a Static, General step named Step-Twist. Apply Encastre to the X = 0 end face. Create a reference point at (150, 10, 5), kinematically couple the complete X = 150 end face to it, and apply moment CM1 = +5000 N-mm about global X. Mesh with C3D8R elements and a 5 mm global seed. Create and run Job-Torsion. Review the torsional shear-stress contours and report UR1 at the loaded reference point. Save C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Torsion.cae and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Torsion.odb.
